svg.title: Mohamed Rayen Sansa — AI · Full-stack · IoT Engineering Student
svg.desc: My name, and beside it a real neural network (64-16-10, 96.7% test accuracy) reading handwritten digits it never saw: the image, its hidden activations, its weights and its output probabilities, all computed by the trained model.
svg.text: ESPRIT engineering student · PFE from Feb 2027
